fun firstNull() = Api.first(null)
fun inArrayNull() = Api.inArray(null)
fun inChoiceNull() = Api.inChoice(null)
fun inExceptNull() = Api.inExcept(null)
fun inHolderNull() = Api.inHolder(null)
fun inListNull() = Api.inList(null)

fun inProductNull() = Api.inProduct(null)
fun pairNull() = Api.pair(null, null)
fun secondNull() = Api.second(null)
